dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jface.text.scrollbar.isVisible>
<!description: Adds an isVisible() check to ScrollBar null check to correctly handle invisible scrollbars.>
<!severity: HINT>
$verticalBar == null :: instanceof($verticalBar, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.ScrollBar")
=>
$verticalBar == null || !$verticalBar.isVisible()
;;
